consolidations.reasoning: All five name the same root: maxPayout default 0 = unlimited + accrual through pause + permissionless burn reading the pot at execution time (NFTBonfire.sol:117-121, 135-139, 148-156). CODE-001 and ECON-001 each say 'same root cause; merge' and F-01-053 says 'dedup against CODE-001/ECON-001 and keep their Low label'. ECON-001's correction is kept in the merged text: pause -> setMaxPayout -> unpause DOES bind the cap; CODE-001's 'pausing first does not help' is superseded. Hazard narrowed to: uncapped default, capping while live, unpausing/enabling without a cap. F-01-053 is retained as a spec cross-reference for spec-conformance.md, not as a second Low. Severity: Low (PATTERN-002 potential-medium preserved in severityNote).

Same root (winner-takes-all pot on a value-blind gate). ECON-002 sizes and weighs it as story-accepted Informational with a UI obligation. PATTERN-001's unpause/setter back-run facet moved to DEDUP-001; its cheap-NFT value-blindness facet is supporting context of DEDUP-003. Kept as a separate finding from DEDUP-001 because the root (ordering on a permissionless pot) and remedy (minPayout/UI) differ from the cap-configuration root.

Exact duplicate (phase 1). Decision on L-04 link: facet (a) NFTMinterV2.burn has no pause check = root of ledger L-04 674c799b2058 (open) → sanitizer reconciles that facet, not re-filed. Facet (b) NFTBonfire pauser unset by default + Pauser.register required = distinct contract, root cause and fix; kept. Also kept separate from DEDUP-001 (different fix locus) but cross-referenced because an unset pauser removes ECON-001's pause-first safe sequence. Flagged Low vs QA for review.

All three identify the same cross-project expired premise (phoenix-nft-staking 858e9e80 / 521c20ad). ECON-004 supplies the numeric re-arm trigger. Kept as an Informational finding for visibility AND routed through manual-review.json MR23-001 per instructions; recommend no yield-claim-nft ledger entry.

mergedAsSupportingContext.reason: Design/sizing note with no standalone defect (contract correct; dilution is intended and budgeted). It is load-bearing for triage: bonfire AM = phUSD dilution, so the 'externally-derived yield = opportunity cost' memory rule must not suppress these findings. Preserved as a guard on each, and the R-sizing (365R unbacked phUSD/yr; R=2.5 → 0.93%/yr; R=25 → 9.3%/yr) is recorded here for the deploy story.

removed.reason: Flags payout < minPayout and payout > 0 as timestamp comparisons. block.timestamp is a linear accrual clock, not entropy (profile weakRandomness: none); post-merge timestamps are fixed per 12s slot, so proposer influence on the pot is at most one slot of accrual (rate x 12s / 1 day), immaterial and protocol-budgeted. The real timing hazards on this function are covered by DEDUP-001/DEDUP-002.
